plan.title: Invalid schedule when converting RFQ to auction

steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ without searching the events list.
Open the RFQ-to-Auction conversion flow and continue to the converted auction create screen.

args.goal: on the converted auction create screen, configure a schedule whose start time is before the original RFQ ended, and stop with that invalid schedule selected

steps.note: Set the invalid schedule that the catalog has no dedicated step for.
Attempt to publish the converted auction with the invalid schedule.
Verify Procol refuses publication with the expected schedule validation message.
